notes: Inbound from self-serve signup (used free credits) - interested in Hosted API for quick experimentation.
Product: building lightweight support automation for small-to-medium e-commerce merchants.

Primary workloads: triage chat agent for agents to shorten handle time, automated ticket summarization, structured extraction of ticket metadata (order_id, sku, severity), and tool-calling to create/update Zendesk tickets.
Latency/throughput: aiming for ~200ms p50 on short prompts, bursty traffic (peak 30-50 reqs/min), cost-sensitive (estimated 50k tokens/month initially).
Model preferences: open-models acceptable (Llama2/Mistral variants), want Redwood-hosted model catalog and ability to fallback to smaller models for cheap tasks.
Integrations: Zendesk + Shopify; needs reliable tool-calling example (webhook + API action) and structured JSON outputs to map to ticket fields.
Security: SMB but requires SSO for admin users, audit logs for actions, U.S. data residency preferred. Asked for SOC2 summary during call.
Sales signal: trial-led; product-led with potential to convert to paid Dedicated later if latency/cost becomes critical.
Quote from call: 'We need something that spits a clean JSON so our backend can map fields without manual parsing.'
AE notes: good technical buyer (CTO present), wants SE walkthrough of POC within 1 week.
POC ask: 4-week sandbox, sample dataset of 2k tickets, scoring on summary accuracy and extraction recall, cost estimates for 50k monthly tokens.
Risk: wants SOC2 doc and clear pricing; if no SOC2, will require legal review which adds 3+ weeks.
Prefer streaming for agent UI and function-calling demo for 'create_ticket' action.
Requested artifacts: quickstart + example tool-calling guide, sample mapping for Zendesk ticket fields (priority, tags, order_id), API key provisioning steps.
Internal notes: follow-up call scheduled for 2026-02-20 with SE to walk through POC plan.
